title: FrankenTerm per-claim evidence-stream sample
description: Canonical JSONL row shape for performance proof-gate evidence consumed by SPRT (G25 ft-tf6g3.10), conformal bands (G26 ft-tf6g3.11), Lindley latency bounds (G23 ft-tf6g3.8), observed-delay heavy-tail quantile bounds (G38 ft-tf6g3.23), KL-divergence regime-shift detection (G42 ft-tf6g3.27), causal-DAG attribution (G43 ft-tf6g3.28), and headline-claim attestation (G19 ft-tf6g3.4 children). Source-of-truth Rust struct: crates/ft-perf-gate/src/lib.rs `EvidenceSample`. Schema-version constant: `EVIDENCE_SAMPLE_SCHEMA_VERSION` = `ft.perf.evidence-sample.v1`. Schema evolution notes: docs/perf/evidence-stream-evolution.md. Substrate for ft-tf6g3.32 (G47).

schema_version.description: Stable schema version for JSONL compatibility. Must match the EVIDENCE_SAMPLE_SCHEMA_VERSION constant in crates/ft-perf-gate/src/lib.rs. Validators must reject rows whose schema_version differs from the version they were built against; migrations are documented in docs/perf/evidence-stream-evolution.md.

ts_ms.description: Event timestamp in Unix milliseconds. Monotone within a single bench run is desirable but not required across runs.

claim_id.description: Stable claim identifier. Conventional shape: `<subsystem>.<metric>` (for example `robot.p95`, `fts5.query_p95`, `renderer.resize_fps_p99`). Must trim non-empty. The hyphen and underscore are allowed; whitespace and shell metacharacters are not.

metric_value.description: Numeric measurement value. Must be finite (no NaN, no infinity). Validators must reject rows whose metric_value is not finite.

metric_unit.description: Unit of `metric_value`. Free-form string; canonical units suggested in the examples list. Validators should normalize unit comparisons to lower-case before equality checks.

sample_size.description: Number of observations represented by this sample. For a Criterion p99 row, this is the underlying sample count Criterion drew from. For a single-shot measurement, this is 1.

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA (short or full hex) that produced the sample. Omit on synthetic / fixture samples; include on every CI-driven measurement.

hardware_fingerprint.description: Stable hardware fingerprint string. Suggested shape: `<cpu-class>-<core-count>-<ram-gb>` (for example `apple-m3-pro-12c-36g`, `intel-xeon-platinum-8488c-4c-16g`). Used by G42 regime-shift and G29 target-class predicate.

runner_sku.description: Runner SKU or target class label. For GitHub Actions: the runner image (`ubuntu-24.04`, `macos-15`). For local: a documented SKU label declared in docs/perf/target-class-hardware.md.

workload_class.description: Workload class used for grouping comparable samples. Examples: `idle-swarm-200-panes`, `resize-storm-20-to-200`, `fts5-fixture-1k-corpus`. Cross-workload-class comparisons require explicit calibration (see G42 regime-shift).

tags.description: Extensible string metadata kept deterministic for JSON output (BTreeMap on the Rust side). Reserved keys: `feature_flags`, `os_version`, `kernel_version`, `gpu_vendor`, `gpu_model`, `frankenterm_version`. Custom keys must use `<vendor>.<key>` namespacing to avoid collision with future reserved keys.
